free_tier.stated: No free text allowance stated; register an account, create an API key and use the OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible endpoint; rate limiting returns HTTP 429 with a retry_after value.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: OpenAI SDK and Anthropic SDK against the two compatible base URLs
chaining: no documented free tier; quota depends on the account, and 429 throttling is the published limit

limits.value: HTTP 429 with retry_after on rate limit

identity_cost.detail: account registration with required information and an API key; no card or phone gate stated

reliability_note: rate limits are enforced and clients are told to use exponential backoff

evidence.proved: the platform requires registration and an API key and enforces rate limits
evidence.quote: When rate limiting is triggered, the API will return HTTP status code 429.

notes: No free allowance on the quickstart page; it cannot be established that any text is free without a signup.
